title: Shunji Shimoyoshi
text:
Hello! My name is Shunji Shimoyoshi and this is my personal website/portfolio. Here, I have listed some of my academic skills and experiences I gained through my time in college as well as activities and communities I have been involved in outside of the classroom.
I am currently an Environmental Studies B.S. major at the University of California, Santa Barbara, focusing on plant ecology and ecological restoration. I currently assist with research in the Carla D’Antonio VEG Lab focusing on ecological restoration practices in coastal California ecosystems. My interest in this field has also led to me to the Cheadle Center for Biodiversity and Ecological Restoration, where I work as a student worker.
